identity.title: Welcome! Pokémon Café: PikaVee's Mixing à la mode volume 1

source.sourceCategory: Category:Welcome! Pokémon Café: PikaVee's Mixing à la mode volumes

leadText:
Volume 1 is the first volume of the Welcome! Pokémon Café: PikaVee's Mixing à la mode manga written by Sanae Suzuki and illustrated by Tomoko Fujinoki. It is 32 pages long.

It contains the 11 chapters serialized as (Japanese: Pokémon Café Mix: PikaVee's Spinning DAYS) and recipes for Pikachu Fruit Flan and Fluffy Eevee Pancakes.
